Vegetation treatment will generally occur within 200 feet of each road centerline, creating a 400-foot-wide gap in fuel continuity.

news.title: Environmental Review No. 8975 - California Climate Investments Hazardous Tree Removal
news.snippet: The proposed project will consist of the removal of hazardous dead, dying, or diseased trees along Huntington Lake Road, Camp Sierra Road, Huntington Lodge Road, and within communities in Zone 10 (see attached map) that pose a public hazard, threaten safe ingress and egress, or threaten habitable structures. The project is approximately 19 miles long and includes a project boundary of approximately 470 acres.

data.desc: In response to the Drought-Resistant Buildings Act (SB 745), the Building Standards Commission (BSC) is proposing amendments to CALGreen, Part 11 of Title 24.The proposed amendments are intended to reduce potable water use in new nonresidential buildings by elevating certain existing voluntary water-efficiency measures to mandatory requirements. The proposed requirements would provide multiple compliance options to accommodate varying building types and regional conditions throughout California. If adopted, the amendments would be incorporated into the 2028 CALGreen, scheduled for publication

data.addr: HMS Security Fencing an Bird Netting
data.desc: The purpose of this project is to repair damaged security fencing and install bird exclusion netting at multiple Caltrans maintenance stations in Inyo and Kern counties. The security fencing a the Tehachapi maintenance station has been damaged and needs to be replaced. In addition, exclusion netting needs to be installed to prevent birds from nesting and roosting in open bays at the Inyokern, Mojave, and Shoshone maintenance stations.

zoningLayers.description: The Kern County Zoning layer contains all zoning districts for the county, with the exclusion of the incorporated cities. The Kern County Zoning Ordinance is Chapter 19 of the Code of Ordinances. This title is adopted to promote and protect the public health, safety, and welfare through the orderly regulation of land uses throughout the unincorporated area of the County.This feature layer is updated periodically throughout each year. For Zoning descriptions, please see the Kern County Zoning Ordinance document located at: https://kernplanning.com/planning/planning-documents/zoning-ordinance/. Last update: 03/04/2026

The proposed requirements would provide multiple compliance options to accommodate varying building types and regional conditions throughout California. If adopted, the amendments would be incorporated into the 2028 CALGreen, scheduled for publication
